<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;0,900;1,300;1,400;1,500;1,600;1,700;1,800;1,900&family=Rubik:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;0,900;1,300;1,400;1,500;1,600;1,700;1,800;1,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Default Body/Content Font: Rubik */
body, body *, p, span, div, a, li, input, button, select, textarea, section, pre, code {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Headings Font: Poppins */
html body h1, html body h2, html body h3, html body h4, html body h5, html body h6,
html body h1 *, html body h2 *, html body h3 *, html body h4 *, html body h5 *, html body h6 *,
html body [class*="heading"], html body .heading, html body .title,
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
h1 *, h2 *, h3 *, h4 *, h5 *, h6 *,
[class*="heading"], .heading, .title {
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif !important;
}
.custom-select {
    position: relative;
    width: 260px;
}

.custom-select select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 60px 10px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #555;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #666;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* Slanted area */
.custom-select::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 3px;
    right: 3px;
    width: 64px;
    height: calc(100% - 6px);
    background: #f0f0f0;

    clip-path: polygon(25% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);

    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Arrow */
.custom-select::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: 22px;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    border-right: 3px solid #666;
    border-bottom: 3px solid #666;
    transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}
  
/* Quantity Selector Styling */
.qty-selector {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    height: 40px;
    position: relative;
    background: #ffffff;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
}
.qty-minus {
    background: #dadada;
    width: 45px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #475569;
    user-select: none;
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 75% 100%, 0 100%);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
}
.qty-minus:hover {
    background: #e2e8f0;
}
.qty-input {
    flex: 1;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1e293b;
    background: #ffffff;
    margin-left: -11.25px;
    margin-right: -11.25px;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
}
.qty-plus {
    background: #dadada;
    width: 45px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #475569;
    user-select: none;
    clip-path: polygon(25% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
}
.qty-plus:hover {
    background: #e2e8f0;
}

/* Product Card Styling */
.prod-card {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.prod-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const minusBtn = e.target.closest(".qty-minus");
        const plusBtn = e.target.closest(".qty-plus");
        
        if (minusBtn) {
            const selector = minusBtn.closest(".qty-selector");
            if (selector) {
                const input = selector.querySelector(".qty-input");
                if (input) {
                    let val = parseInt(input.value) || 1;
                    if (val > 1) {
                        input.value = val - 1;
                        input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (plusBtn) {
            const selector = plusBtn.closest(".qty-selector");
            if (selector) {
                const input = selector.querySelector(".qty-input");
                if (input) {
                    let val = parseInt(input.value) || 1;
                    input.value = val + 1;
                    input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
                }
            }
        }
    });
});
</script>
